_note: Written 2026-10-19 from tool names and descriptions only, before any engine ran on it; no TEST row or engine answer was read.

study.description: Run a guided simulation study in a study folder: start, status, steps, validation, versions, reports, control room, sensitivity, animation, package, slides.

model_editing.description: Edit the open model: blocks and links, resources, calendar, entity types, settings, scenarios, warm start, layout, undo, write a whole model, read its summary or JSON.

records_data.description: Records, tables, networks and orders of a model, and bringing data in: list or change records, CSV tables and time series, nodes and segments, routing sequences, orders, imports from other tools, fitting distributions to data.

run_analysis.description: Run a model and analyse the results: KPI digest and tables, scenario comparison, investment case, replications to a precision, reality checks, loop dominance, warm-up, export.

experiments_optimisation.description: Experiments on a model: optimise parameters, calibrate to measurements, fit a surrogate over a design of experiments, evaluate a decision policy.

twin_plant.description: The digital twin and plant data: what the plant looks like now, the twin's forecast and recommendations, a plant timeline, forecasting from the current state, data bindings.

debugging.description: Debug and check a model: step a run under the debugger, inspect its state, validate a model and get fix hints.

reference_help.description: Reference and help: block types, distributions, the expression language, the model file format, finding the right tool.

workspace_files.description: The workspace and its files: create, open, save and list models.
